title: O. Design system and kit
description: The product's design system and its kit of visual components, on the `design-system` branch. `mock/design/design.json` (the `design` shape below) records where the tokens of `mock/design/tokens.json` (W3C design tokens, derived into `mock/design/tokens.css` by the harness) came from and whether a human validated them. `mock/kit/kit.json` (the `kit` shape) lists the kit's components, each a fragment `mock/kit/<Name>.html` a page or a micro-frontend injects with `<div data-kit="<Name>">`: a visual primitive below the Micro-UI, consuming the tokens through `var(--…)`, reaching no network, holding no data of its own.

state.description: Nothing yet; tokens waiting for the human's validation; validated — the kit may be generated and the code stage installs the tokens.

source.description: A tokens file handed over, or tokens drawn by an AI from the moodboard and the logo.

brief.description: What the human wrote for the generation: the brand, the mood.

logo.description: The logo, relative to `mock/design/`, or empty.

candidate.description: A candidate waits in `mock/design/candidate.json` beside the validated tokens.

issue.description: The roadmap issue that installs the design system in the product's frontend, once validated.

checked.description: The harness's bases the human ticked, by id (`button`, `carousel`…).

base.description: The harness base it is styled from, or empty for a custom component.

what.description: What it shows and does, visually.

prompt.description: The human's prompt for a custom component.

reference.description: A reference image, relative to `mock/kit/`, or empty.

variantOf.description: The component this one was forked from on the kit's canvas.

recoded.description: Written by the code stage when it recoded the fragment for real: what changed, one line. The factory view shows it as a pin on the component.
